en.summary: Fixes ComfyUI being taken over and image failures without explanation, and makes character creation and image generation better.
changes: ComfyUI is no longer taken over: only the FreeVideo launcher opens FreeVideo, and ComfyUI opened any other way stays as it is.
Image failures explain themselves: the reason and the next step are shown, with export report and open issue, and a new request now waits for the image in progress instead of failing.
Image view: the left panel is no longer cut off in Chinese, and the "Clear" button under the prompt is gone.
Calmer background: it no longer flickers while playing or switching and its colour is softer; the update notice can be closed and returns next time.

Better character creation: outfits from a description or a clothing picture are applied more reliably, including the face close-up; side and back views no longer show a grid; photo, uploaded picture and AI all give a face close-up, front, side and back view, each editable.
Faster pictures on graphics cards with more video memory.
Photos the right way up: phone photos used as references keep their orientation, and region edits at another size no longer fail.
Export report: saving over an existing file now works.
Compatibility: other CUDA or cuDNN copies on the system no longer load the wrong libraries; the launcher says clearly when no NVIDIA driver is found; Linux installs need less disk space.
Editing: undo still works after a generation, and unsaved changes are kept when switching views.
Model installs: verification shows "Verifying" with real progress.

Also: the creative panel's buttons wrap in narrow windows instead of scrolling out of sight, the quality slider follows the pointer more closely, and clothing options and LoRA share one row when creating a character.

zh.summary: 修复了打开 ComfyUI 被接管、出图失败没有提示等问题，角色创建和出图更好用。
changes: ComfyUI 不再被接管：只有从 FreeVideo 启动器打开才进入 FreeVideo，其他方式打开的 ComfyUI 保持原样。
出图失败说清原因：显示原因和下一步，可以导出报告、提交问题；有图片正在生成时，新的请求会排队，不再直接失败。
图像视图：中文界面下左栏不再被切掉，提示词下去掉了“清空”键。
背景更舒服：播放和切换时背景不再闪烁，颜色更柔和；更新提示可以关闭，下次打开再提醒。
角色创建更好用：按描述或服装图换衣更准，脸部特写也换上新衣服；侧面和背面不再有网格纹；照片、上传图片、AI 生成都能得到脸部特写、正面、侧面、背面，每张可单独编辑。
出图更快：显存较大的显卡上出图更快。
照片方向正确：手机拍的照片作参考时按正确方向使用；局部编辑换了尺寸也不再失败。
导出报告：覆盖已有的同名文件时也能正常保存。
兼容性：系统里装有其他 CUDA 或 cuDNN 时不再加载错误的库；找不到 NVIDIA 驱动时启动器给出明确提示；Linux 安装需要的磁盘空间更少。
剪辑：生成之后仍可撤销，切换视图时未保存的修改会保留。
模型安装：安装校验时显示“正在校验”和真实进度。
其他：窄窗口下创作面板的按钮会换行，不再滑出视野；质量滑块拖动更跟手；新建角色时服装选项和 LoRA 在同一行。

en.summary: The new interface is friendlier, smoother and more modern, and privacy protection is stronger.
changes: New interface: friendlier, smoother and more modern. Every running and queued video and picture can be seen and managed from any page. Generation keeps running when you switch pages, and your half-written prompt and reference pictures stay in place. Earlier videos can serve as references, and first and last frames can be picked straight from your works. A light theme is also available.
Stronger privacy: deleting a work also deletes its uploaded pictures and prompts, and downloads and shares leave out the prompt by default.
Image generation with more control: LoRA is supported, and hand-drawn sketches give finer control over the result. A picture deleted by mistake can be recovered from Recently deleted.
Characters from a photo: one photo makes a character card with front, side and back views.
Editor: the microphone is turned off automatically when you leave the editor, what has been recorded is kept when you stop with Esc, and export defaults to the full video at high quality.
Works library: works can be viewed and played properly even in a narrow window.
More reliable Mac installation: fixes an issue that kept the installation from completing on some Macs.
More reliable generation: prompt enhancement fails less often on 12 GB graphics cards, and graphics cards with little memory generate pictures normally.
Download and launcher: a video that cannot be downloaded now says so, and the launcher starts normally even if its saved template is missing or damaged.
Built-in director and agent tools: the director's choices and shot joining are shown in the conversation, a job's queue position is reported, and more clients are supported.
ComfyUI console: each log line now appears once.
Tutorial: new chapters on closing the launcher, repairing model files and making pictures of different shapes on a canvas.

zh.summary: 全新界面带来更友好、丝滑、现代的体验，隐私保护进一步加强。
changes: 全新界面：更友好、丝滑、现代的体验。在任何页面都能看到和管理所有正在生成、排队的视频和图片；切换页面不会中断生成，写到一半的描述和参考图都还在；以前生成的视频也可以直接用作参考，首尾帧可以从作品中直接选；支持浅色主题。
隐私保护加强：删除作品时一并删除相关的上传图片和提示词，下载和分享默认不含提示词。
图片生成更可控：支持 LoRA，并可以通过手绘草图更精细地控制生成；误删的图片可在“最近删除”中找回。
照片生成角色：支持用一张照片生成角色卡，包括正面、侧面和背面形象。
剪辑：离开剪辑页面时自动关闭麦克风，按 Esc 结束录制时已录内容会保留，导出默认选择完整视频和高画质。
作品库：窄窗口下也能正常查看和播放作品。
Mac 安装更稳定：修复部分 Mac 无法完成安装的问题。
生成更稳定：12 GB 显卡上的提示词增强更不容易失败，显存较小的显卡也能正常生成图片。
下载与启动：视频无法下载时会给出提示，保存的模板缺失或损坏时启动器也能正常启动。
内置导演与智能体工具：导演的选择和镜头拼接过程显示在对话中，智能体工具会报告任务的排队位置，并兼容更多客户端。
ComfyUI 控制台：每行日志只显示一次。
教程：新增关闭启动器、修复模型文件、在画布上做不同比例图片三章。

en.summary: Closing the launcher offers Exit or Run in background. Offline installation saves disk space and reuses an existing model folder. An interrupted second pass resumes from its last completed step, the second pass uses less graphics memory, and extending the same video again starts sooner. Picture shape can be chosen on a canvas with pictures, and several installation stops are fixed.
changes: Closing the launcher: a choice appears with Exit, which stops generation and quits, and Run in background, which hides the window while generation continues and can be reopened or quit from the tray icon (the menu bar icon on Mac).

Second pass: after an interruption by a lack of system memory, the retry continues from the last completed step instead of starting again, and the result is identical to an uninterrupted run. At high resolution the second pass uses up to about 2 GB less graphics memory, which leaves 8 GB cards more room. With a long reference video, a refused locked-page copy falls back to ordinary memory instead of failing the second pass at its start.

Extending videos: memory for the ending clip is estimated from its real size, so a loaded model is no longer released and read from disk again. Extending the same video again does not encode its ending a second time, so the next extension starts sooner.

Offline installation: importing the runtime package again in place counts model packs that are already installed, without unpacking them again or keeping two copies. An existing model folder can be chosen when installing from the runtime package, and matching models are used directly, which saves a download of about 49 GiB. After a move, model pack status follows the new location, and imported folders have shorter paths, so an installation in an ordinary folder starts from where it is.

Model files: when a model file differs from the tested version, the failure card names the package to import again, and the original file is kept under a new name while the version from the package replaces it.

Pictures: choose the shape of a new picture on a canvas that already holds pictures; with another shape the new picture is placed on a new canvas and can be undone in one step. A long description expands only while focused and shows on one line otherwise, so a multi-line description no longer moves the canvas in narrow windows. Prompt rewriting without pictures keeps the unused vision part in main memory when it would leave little graphics memory to spare.
Launcher and image models: while an image model is in use, Repair and Delete are gray, with the reason and what to do written beside them.

Linux installation: the chosen drive is checked first, and FAT32, exFAT or a location that does not allow running programs stops the installation with an explanation and a request to choose another drive.

Windows installation: setup no longer stops at a PowerShell debugger prompt, and the launcher no longer stops at the check step with Access denied when Windows briefly holds a file that was just written; it retries for a few seconds and then copies the folder into place. Installing node dependencies and updating the engine also use short paths.
Export and dubbing: several calculations no longer depend on a component that Windows application control can block, and the output is unchanged.

Long videos and reports: when the record of a seam is missing, that part is generated again once; a seam that still has no record at join time is joined directly, so the video can still be saved. Failed long video requests, chat sends and high-resolution image runs leave the diagnostic report the facts needed to find the cause.

zh.summary: 关闭启动器时可选“退出”或“后台运行”。离线安装更省空间，并可直接使用已有模型文件夹。第二遍被中断后从已完成的步骤继续，第二遍少占显存，再次续写同一个视频起步更快。已有图片的画布可以选择新图比例，Windows 和 Linux 的若干安装中断问题已修复。
changes: 关闭启动器：弹出选择，“退出”停止生成并退出，“后台运行”隐藏窗口、生成继续，可从托盘图标（Mac 为菜单栏图标）重新打开或退出。
第二遍：因系统内存不足中断后，重试从已完成的步骤继续，不再全部重做，结果与不中断时完全一致。高分辨率时第二遍最多少占约 2 GB 显存，8 GB 显卡的余量更大。带长参考视频时，锁页内存被系统拒绝就改用普通内存，不再在第二遍开始时整个失败。
续写：按结尾片段的实际大小估算内存，已载入的模型不再被放掉、重新读盘。续写同一个视频时不再重复编码它的结尾，再次续写起步更快。
离线安装：原地重新导入运行环境包时，已装好的模型包直接算数，不再重新解压，也不再占双份空间。用运行环境包安装时也能选已有的模型文件夹，对得上的模型直接使用，免下约 49 GiB。换了安装位置后，模型包状态按新位置显示；导入后的文件夹路径变短，放在普通文件夹里的安装直接从原位置启动。
模型文件：模型文件与测试过的版本不一致时，出错卡片写明重新导入哪个包；原文件改名保留，再换成包里的版本。
图片：画布已有图片时可选择新图的比例；选了别的比例，新图放在新画布上，可一次撤销。较长的描述只在输入框获得焦点时展开，否则以一行加省略号显示，窄窗口里输入多行描述时画布不再被顶动。无图的提示词改写在显存余量不大时，把用不到的视觉部分留在内存。
启动器与图像模型：图像模型正在使用时，“修复”“删除”变灰，旁边写明原因和怎么做。
Linux 安装：安装前检查所选硬盘，FAT32、exFAT 或不允许运行程序的位置会先停下并说明，请选择其他硬盘。
Windows 安装：安装不再停在 PowerShell 调试提示符；Windows 短暂占用刚写好的文件时，启动器不再停在检查步骤报“访问被拒绝”，改为重试数秒再复制到位。安装节点依赖、更新引擎时也使用短路径。
导出和配音：几处计算不再依赖可能被 Windows 应用控制拦截的组件，输出不变。
长视频与报告：接缝记录缺失时，该段重新生成一次；合并时仍缺少记录的接缝按直接拼接保存，不再因此无法保存。长视频提交、聊天发送和高分辨率图片生成失败时，诊断报告记下判断原因所需的信息。

en.summary: Short films are finished for you: the built-in director picks and joins the takes, the film arrives in Autopilot as a card, and an editing project with one part per shot is ready. H3 Image takes up to 16 reference pictures, and consecutive images start sooner. Imported clips can be removed from the editor, and waits, failures, setup and narrow windows read more clearly.
changes: Short films: a screenplay can carry its outline and the blocking of each scene, and the blocking goes into every shot of that scene. With the built-in director, takes are chosen and joined automatically once they are shot, and the work continues after a pause, a resume or a restart. The finished film appears in the Autopilot conversation as a card that plays, opens or goes straight to editing, and it also opens as an editing project with one part per shot.

Reference pictures: H3 Image accepts up to 16 reference pictures and Qwen-Image 2.1 accepts four. A note appears when too many pictures are added at once, pictures that cannot fit are refused before the run starts, and Generate points to the pictures to remove when the selected model's limit is exceeded.

Image speed: consecutive images keep the models loaded when the graphics card and memory allow, and the same prompt is not encoded again, so the second image onward starts sooner. Results are saved as high-quality JPEG, and temporary uploads are removed after each run.

Editor: the Imported tab has a remove button on every clip, including ones that could not be opened. Only FreeVideo's copy is deleted, never the original file, and a clip that an edit uses, even in an earlier version, asks for a second confirmation. Work thumbnails in the media library display correctly, and the Edit button on finished-video cards is visible again.

Waits: prompt rewriting counts from the press, the size range shows Estimating while it is worked out, and starting a generation or opening the page from the launcher shows elapsed seconds after 3 s. Automatic subtitles show Unpacking, Autopilot shows Sending and the seconds spent waiting for a reply, and preparing reference media shows which file is in progress.

Failures and settings: a missing or damaged model file is explained on the failure card, and cards that suggest a repair have an Open settings button that goes to Detect & review. Offline installations are told to import the offline package again. A damaged reserved memory setting no longer blocks the settings panel or generation, and a refused save is explained under Save. The launcher report form names the real failure.

Install and repair: Check and repair list and download again any model file that is missing or damaged, and importing an offline package again completes files left short by an interrupted copy. An installation with a missing model folder no longer stops at the GPU check, and an engine source folder that cannot be read is built again instead of failing every retry. The setup plan shows small sizes in MB or KB, and unavailable buttons share one gray look.

Windows and downloads: when Windows application control blocks a component file, the GPU check and generation continue, and the block is recognised in any system language. Cards of 16 GB and more keep copying the next layer while the current one computes when commit headroom is limited. The runtime download keeps retrying the official source when a mirror refuses access, with one more public source added.

Narrow windows: the Autopilot conversation scrolls on its own with the header and input in view, and an unsent message shows its reason on its own line. The studio shows the queued count and each run's size and length in full, download size and speed stay together, export choices and the reserved memory title stay on one line, and setup lines wrap between phrases. The Connect an agent card keeps its arrow with its words, and a failed lookup shows only Retry and Report a problem.

Nodes view: switching to it no longer leaves a node under the view bar, and the voice reference, dialogue tail and empty prompt switches show Chinese names in the Chinese interface. The media panel says once, not three times, when some saved items cannot be read.

Generation: a queue read that receives a web page instead of data is retried like a lost connection, so repeating generation keeps going. A second-pass memory failure that a smaller retry cannot help is reported sooner.
Tutorial: new chapters on beat snapping, run status, generating with reference pictures, the outline and staging of a short film, and the editing project a finished film leaves.

zh.summary: 短剧可以一路做完：内置导演自动选片并接成影片，成片以卡片出现在 AI 全自动对话中，同时建好按镜头分段的剪辑工程。H3 Image 支持最多 16 张参考图，连续出图起步更快。剪辑器可以删除已导入素材，等待、失败、安装和窄窗口的显示更清楚。
changes: 短剧：剧本可以写大纲和每场站位，站位自动写进该场每个镜头。选用内置导演时，拍完后自动选片并接成影片，暂停、继续和重启后都会接着做。成片以卡片出现在 AI 全自动对话中，可以播放、打开或直接进入剪辑，同时建好按镜头分段的剪辑工程。
参考图：H3 Image 最多可用 16 张参考图，Qwen-Image 2.1 可用 4 张。一次加入过多时显示提示，放不下的参考图在开始前拒绝；超出所选模型上限时，点“生成”会定位到需要移除的图。
出图速度：显存和内存允许时，连续生成图片保持模型常驻，同一提示词不再重复编码，第二张起开始得更快。结果保存为高质量 JPEG，每次生成后清理临时上传。
剪辑器：“已导入”页的每个素材（包括打不开的）都有删除按钮，只删除软件复制的副本，不删原文件；被剪辑使用的素材（包括只在早先版本中使用的）需再确认一次。素材库中的作品缩略图正常显示，已完成视频卡片上的“剪辑”按钮重新显示。
等待：提示词改写从点下就计秒，可生成范围计算时显示“正在估算…”，开始生成和从启动器打开页面超过 3 秒时显示已用秒数。自动字幕解压时显示“正在解压”，AI 全自动显示“正在发送…”和等待回复的秒数，准备参考素材时显示正在处理第几个文件。
失败和设置：缺失或损坏的模型文件在失败卡片上说明原因；建议修复的卡片新增“打开设置”，直接定位到“检测并预览”。离线安装改为提示重新导入离线包。预留显存设置文件损坏时，设置面板和生成照常进行；保存被拒时在“保存”下说明原因。启动器的报告表单写出真实的失败原因。
安装和修复：检测和修复会列出并重新下载缺失或损坏的模型文件，重新导入离线包会补全复制中断留下的不完整文件。缺少模型文件夹时，安装不再停在 GPU 检查一步；引擎源码目录无法读取时改为重新构建，不再每次重试都失败。安装计划中较小的文件以 MB 或 KB 显示，不可用的按钮统一为灰色。
Windows 和下载：Windows 应用控制拦截某个组件文件时，GPU 检查和生成照常继续，在任何系统语言下都能识别该拦截。提交余量受限时，16 GB 及以上显卡在计算当前层的同时仍会拷贝下一层。运行环境下载在镜像拒绝访问时继续重试官方线路，并新增一个公开备用线路。
窄窗口：AI 全自动的对话单独滚动，顶栏和输入框始终可见，没发出的消息原因单独显示一行。创作面板完整显示排队数量以及每条的尺寸和时长，下载进度的大小和速度不再拆开，导出选项和预留显存标题保持一行，安装页文字按词组换行。连接 Agent 卡片的箭头不再和文字分开，获取地址失败时只显示重试和提交问题。
节点视图：切换过来时节点不再被顶部的视图切换栏遮住，“声音参考”“隐藏对白尾段”“允许空描述”三个开关显示中文名称。素材区有资料读取失败时只提示一次，不再重复三次。
生成：队列读取得到网页而不是数据时按断线重试，重复生成不再被停掉。第二遍显存不足且缩小重试也无济于事时，更早报告失败。
教程：新增对齐音乐节拍、运行状态、用参考图生成图片、短剧的大纲和站位、短剧成片的剪辑工程五章。

en.summary: The editor shows its preview and timeline again, and Mac installs no longer stop at the GPU check. Images show each step while they generate, have a Seed field and clearer failure cards, and narrow windows fit better.
changes: Editor: the edit page keeps its layout again, so the preview and the timeline are no longer pushed off the screen by the media library.
Mac install: an installation or repair no longer stops at the GPU check step when every check has passed.

Install and update: a first installation offers H3 Video or H3 Image, and an image-only installation adds the video model later. Graphics package downloads keep trying through a slow connection, a model download that cannot resume starts again, an update restores a missing tool, and setup waits briefly for another running installation and names it.

Images view: the picture is shown after each step while it generates, and progress follows time with one percentage and the remaining time. A Seed field under Advanced keeps a number, or draws a new seed for each picture when empty.

Picture failures: the reason and Retry sit inside the card, Autopilot cards open technical details as video cards do, and memory reasons use formal wording. The report button reads "Download report" on the image page, in Autopilot and in the editor.
Edit page: the quality setting sits beside Generate and shows the number of steps. Music on the second sound track starts from its own description box.
Output: an Output setting can write a separate 10-bit copy of each generated video; the regular file and the page preview are unchanged.

Narrow windows: the node view top bar steps entries aside and then wraps, the view switch sits in the same place in every view, and Escape in the phone panel closes only the panel. At 400 px the image model name and ratio menu show whole, image editor tools wrap, the result menu opens upward when needed, and editor track names show in full.
Autopilot: Enter, Ctrl+Enter and paste work in the chat and image pages, the message hint fits one line on phones, the header keeps a readable job title, and long titles stay inside the job card.
Progress: long quiet stages of a video run show real counts, such as frames, layers or files, after the stage text.

Generation: the text encoder loads faster from slow drives when memory is short, and a loaded engine is reused when only the tiling changes. A library character's voice comes into the shot with its pictures, and prompt enhancement reads the picture or video of a connected load node.

Tutorial and messages: the tutorial adds chapters on making pictures, middle frames and saving a frame. A refusal caused by Reserved VRAM names that setting, the connection card names the localhost address to open, and a long-video join failure says whether the seam record is missing or unreadable.

zh.summary: 编辑页重新显示预览和时间线，Mac 安装不再停在 GPU 检查一步；图片生成时逐步显示画面，新增种子输入，失败卡片更清楚，窄窗口排版更合适。
changes: 编辑页：版面恢复正常，预览和时间线不再被素材库挤出屏幕。
Mac 安装：安装或修复时，各项检查都已通过却仍停在 GPU 检查一步的问题已修复。
安装和更新：首次安装可选 H3 Video 或 H3 Image，只装图像模型的以后可再加视频模型。GPU 组件下载在网络慢时持续重试，无法续传的模型下载重新开始，更新补回缺失的工具，另一个安装进行中时稍等并说明是哪一个。
图像视图：生成时每一步都显示当前画面，进度按时间推进，只显示一个百分比和剩余时间。“高级”里新增“种子”，填数字固定种子，留空则每张图重新取种子。
图片失败：原因和“重试”放在卡片内，AI 全自动中的卡片和视频卡片一样可展开技术详情，内存不足的原因改为书面措辞。图像页、AI 全自动和编辑页的报告按钮统一为“下载报告”。
编辑页：画质设置放在“生成”旁边，并显示步数。第二条声音轨上的音乐从自己的描述框开始填写。
输出：可在设置中另外写一份 10 位视频，原有文件和页面预览不变。
窄窗口：节点视图顶栏的入口先依次让位再折行，各视图的切换位置一致，手机面板里按 Esc 只关闭面板。400 宽下图像模型名称和比例菜单完整显示，图像编辑工具折行，结果菜单放不下时向上展开，剪辑轨道名称完整显示。
AI 全自动：对话页和图像页的 Enter、Ctrl+Enter 和粘贴恢复正常，手机上的输入提示一行放下，顶栏保留可读的任务名，长标题不再超出任务卡片。
进度：视频生成中较长的无变化阶段，在阶段文字后显示真实计数，例如帧数、层数或文件数。
生成：内存紧张时，文本编码器从慢速硬盘加载更快；只有分块变化时复用已加载的引擎。素材库角色的声音随其图片一起带入镜头，提示词增强会读取所连加载节点中的图片或视频。
教程和提示：教程新增生成图片、中间帧和保存帧三章。只因“预留显存”导致的拒绝会指出该设置，连接卡片会给出应打开的 localhost 地址，长视频拼接失败时说明接缝记录是缺失还是无法读取。

en.summary: Installing only an image model works again, and the image view shows its pictures again. Uploads show progress, and the update notice, retry notice and reference Add menu are clearer.
changes: Install: installing only an image model no longer fails at the verification step for lacking video model folders; the check for a video install is unchanged.
Image view: the large picture, the work thumbnails and the save link no longer return 404.
Uploads: while a file is uploaded or an edited image is saved, the media panel shows how much has been sent.
Update notice: it is a full-width bar, under the header in the studio and as the second row of the node toolbar.
Retry notice: when a run is retried, the notice says the run mode changes, and names less video memory or less memory by cause, instead of saying settings change.
Reference Add menu: it opens above when there is no room below, takes the full width on narrow windows and shows four columns at 400 px wide.
Studio: the mention list refreshes when a tour sample fills the prompt.
Tutorial and tour: video and audio references are added with Add, the same way as images, and the first-and-last-frame step no longer repeats Add.
Agent: the width and height descriptions state the nearest-multiple-of-32 rule, and whole-timeline write points to the editor operations for clip edits.
Image view: when there are many works, the thumbnails in the works column are shown in full instead of being squeezed into thin strips.
Image view: the large picture shows square, portrait and landscape pictures whole at every width.

zh.summary: 只装图像模型的安装恢复正常，图像视图的图片重新显示；上传显示进度，更新提示、重试提示和参考图“添加”菜单更清楚。
changes: 安装：只安装图像模型时，安装不再在“验证安装”一步因缺少视频模型目录而失败；安装视频模型时的检查不变。
图像视图：大图、作品缩略图和保存链接不再 404。
上传：上传文件或保存编辑后的图片时，素材面板显示已发送的比例。
更新提示：改为通栏，创作面板里在标题下，节点视图里是工具条的第二行。
重试提示：运行自动重试时，提示写明换了一种运行方式，并按原因写“更省显存”或“更省内存”，不再写“调整设置”。
参考图“添加”菜单：下方没有位置时向上展开，窄窗口通宽，400 宽下为四列。
创作面板：示例图填入描述后，@ 提及列表同步刷新。
教程与导览：视频和音频参考与图片一样点“添加”，首尾帧一步不再重复“添加”。
Agent：宽高说明写明取最近的 32 的倍数；整条时间线写入指向剪辑操作，避免用它改片段。
图像视图：作品较多时，作品栏的缩略图完整显示，不再被压成一条条。
图像视图：大图完整显示方图、竖图和横图。

en.summary: H3 Image arrives: a new Images view for H3 Image and Qwen-Image 2.1, pictures up to 16 MP on graphics cards from 8 GB, and Autopilot pictures follow the installed model. Beat lines join the editor, and launcher failures, settings and cards are clearer.
changes: H3 Image: a new image model for NVIDIA graphics cards from 8 GB of video memory, making pictures from 4 MP up to 16 MP. It is installed alone or added to an existing video install, which downloads only the missing files, about 22 GB, and shares the text encoder already installed. One weight file serves every graphics card, and machines with little memory load it in mapped form. Not available on Mac or AMD.

Images view: H3 Image and Qwen-Image 2.1 share one prompt box, and finished pictures gather in the Works column. Generated pictures are saved to the asset library and appear under Images in the reference "+" menu. The More menu offers Open folder, Copy prompt and Delete. The empty stage shows sample pictures, and the page has a wider layout, a solid Generate button and a clearer error card. H3 Image does not take reference pictures yet. With the prompt rewrite model installed, the "FreeToken enhancement" switch rewrites H3 Image prompts without adding anything the request did not ask for.
Autopilot: picture requests use the installed H3 Image at 4 MP or 16 MP; a request below 4 MP is made at 4 MP in the same shape.
Editor: beat lines on the music track, and clips snap to the beats. The feature tour now starts on the clip just imported.
Keyframes: still pictures can be placed between the first and last frame, and each is generated one at a time.

Audio: with "Use as is" selected and no audio connected, FreeVideo now says so before generating. When audio used as is cannot be generated in parts, the reason is shown and the request stops before it is submitted.
Windows: on machines with tight system memory, the second pass no longer stops and restarts for lack of memory. The video is unchanged.
Long videos: very long high-resolution requests no longer stop on the first step with a numerical error.
Sampling preview: an optional small preview decoder on CUDA, used only when it does not slow generation.
Settings: the working files of finished videos can be cleared.

Launcher: a failure shows one card with the next step and the buttons that resolve it, and the technical details are folded away. A CUDA initialization failure comes with the step to take, an outdated driver gets a card asking to update the driver, and a failed update records why each source failed.

Interface details: checkboxes share one size; the Passes field is as compact as the Reserved VRAM field; media cards no longer show a mode label; editing a character puts the cursor in its name; Autopilot cards show "Custom" for a custom quality and a single progress percentage; and the header and view tabs fit narrow windows without overlap or sideways scrolling.

zh.summary: H3 Image 上线：图像视图同时支持两个图像模型，8 GB 显存起即可出最高 16 MP 的图片，AI 全自动出图按已安装的模型生成；剪辑新增拍点线，启动器失败提示、设置和卡片更清楚。
changes: H3 Image：新增图像模型，适用于 8 GB 显存起的 NVIDIA 显卡，可出 4 MP 到 16 MP 的图片。可单独安装，也可加装到已有的视频安装上，加装只下载缺少的文件，约 22 GB，并共用已安装的文本编码器；所有显卡用同一份权重文件，内存较小的机器按映射方式加载。Mac 和 AMD 暂不可用。

图像视图：H3 Image 和 Qwen-Image 2.1 共用一个提示词输入框，生成的图片集中在“作品”栏。生成的图片会存入素材库，并出现在参考图“+”菜单的“图片”下；“更多”菜单提供打开文件夹、复制提示词和删除。空白舞台显示示例图，页面布局更宽，“生成”按钮始终实心，出错时显示更清楚的提示卡。H3 Image 暂不支持参考图。装有提示词改写模型时，可打开“FreeToken 提示词增强”改写 H3 Image 的提示词，不会加入请求里没有的内容。
AI 全自动：出图请求用已安装的 H3 Image 按 4 MP 或 16 MP 生成；不足 4 MP 的请求按同一比例出 4 MP。
剪辑：音乐轨新增拍点线，片段可吸附到拍点；功能导览改为从刚导入的片段开始。
关键帧：首帧和尾帧之间可放置静态图片，每次生成一张。
音频：选了“原样使用”但没有连接音频时，生成前就会提示；原样使用的音频无法分段生成时，会说明原因并在提交前停止。
Windows：系统内存紧张的机器上，第二遍不再因内存不足而中途停止并重试；生成的视频不变。
长视频：很长的高分辨率请求不再在第一步因数值错误停止。
采样预览：CUDA 上新增可选的小预览解码器，只在不拖慢生成时启用。
设置：可清理已完成视频的工作文件。
启动器：失败时只显示一张卡，写明下一步和能解决问题的按钮，技术详情折叠；CUDA 初始化失败会给出可操作的步骤，显卡驱动过旧时显示更新驱动的卡，更新失败时记录每个来源失败的原因。
界面细节：勾选框统一大小；“轮数”输入框与“预留显存”输入框一样紧凑；素材卡不再显示模式标签；编辑角色时光标先落在名字上；AI 全自动卡片在自定义质量时显示“自定义”，进度只显示一个百分比；顶栏和视图标签在窄窗口里不再重叠，也不再横向滚动。
